_comment: Two Embarcadero Center, San Francisco — hypothetical acquisition. Building facts (size, ownership, occupancy) are real and sourced. Deal terms and financial assumptions are OUR JUDGMENT calibrated to published market data — the building is not for sale and these are not its actual economics. Sources listed in each input's 'basis' field and in SOURCES.md. Not investment advice.

property.name: Two Embarcadero Center
property.basis: 789K SF, 45 stories, owned by BXP since 1998 (bxp.com property page). Hypothetical deal — not actually for sale.

purchase_price.label: Purchase price
purchase_price.basis: $494/SF. Judgment, bracketed by 2026 comps: reset value-add trades in the low-to-mid $300s/SF (550 Kearny, 455 Market guidance, TheRealDeal 5/2026) vs. trophy pricing at $900+/SF (Transamerica Pyramid complex $922/SF Q1'26 per CBRE; 101 California asking ~$900/SF, SF Standard 1/2026). An 85%-leased EC tower sits between.

closing_costs_pct.label: Closing costs (% of price)
closing_costs_pct.basis: Judgment. Title, legal, SF transfer tax.

in_place_rent_psf.label: In-place rent ($/SF, gross)
in_place_rent_psf.basis: Set slightly below asking. Q2'26 SF citywide asking $70.31 gross, CBD Class A $76.60 (Cushman & Wakefield); Q1'26 direct asking $71.19 FSG (CBRE), $67.77 (Newmark). In-place on a stabilized tower typically trails asking.

rent_growth_pct.label: Annual rent growth
rent_growth_pct.basis: Asking rents +3.7% YoY Q1'26 (CBRE), +3.4% (Kidder). But Newmark notes rents 'hovered around $68 for six quarters' — so the low end of the band is zero, not 2%.

occupancy_pct.label: Current occupancy
occupancy_pct.basis: BXP: Embarcadero Center office space ~85% occupied (SF Standard, 7/2025). BXP SF region overall 79.7% (bxp.com, 4/2026).

stabilized_occupancy_pct.label: Stabilized occupancy
stabilized_occupancy_pct.basis: Class A Tier 1 direct vacancy is 8.2% (C&W Q2'26) — i.e. ~92% occupancy for the best assets. Band spans citywide-average pessimism vs. Tier 1 performance.

months_to_stabilize.label: Months to stabilize
months_to_stabilize.basis: Judgment. Market context: 5 consecutive quarters of positive absorption, strongest leasing since 2019 (C&W Q2'26), AI tenants driving demand (CBRE Q1'26).

opex_psf.label: Operating expenses ($/SF, incl. RE tax)
opex_psf.basis: Derived. BOMA's last published SF figure was $11.85/SF (2018, excludes property tax) — dated. Prop 13 resets tax basis at sale: ~1.18% on $390M ≈ $5.80/SF alone. Plus insurance and utility escalation since 2018, mid-$20s all-in is our estimate. The weakest-sourced input in this model — which is worth knowing, because it ranks #2 in the sensitivity table.

opex_growth_pct.label: Annual opex growth
opex_growth_pct.basis: Judgment, CPI-anchored. Insurance has run hotter than CPI in recent years, hence the asymmetric band.

reserves_psf.label: Capital reserves ($/SF)
reserves_psf.basis: Judgment. Typical lender requirement. Understated for a 1970s-80s vintage tower — see SOURCES.md.

exit_cap_pct.label: Exit cap rate
exit_cap_pct.basis: Judgment against listed averages: SF commercial cap rates ~6.08% (LoopNet) to 6.29% (CityFeet) across asset types, 2026. CBRE 2026 Outlook expects 5–15bps of compression for quality assets. Office should price wide of the blended average; band widened to 7.00% on the high side for office-specific risk.
